description.value: This profile defines the FHIR Composition for the Patient Summary document. It is derived from the HL7 International Patient Summary (IPS) Composition profile and specifies the structure, mandatory sections, and constraints required to support the exchange of a Patient Summary in accordance with the Xt-EHR and European Health Data Space (EHDS) specifications.

purpose.value: This profile is the FHIR implementation of the Patient Summary[Patient Summary](https://decor.nictiz.nl/ad/#/gbb2026bbr-/datasets/dataset/PatientSummary).
